### Strategic Briefing for Future Diplomacy Games vs. These Models

As Austria in this game, I started strong through a flawless AT alliance with Turkey, capturing SER, BUL, GRE, and pressuring RUM/SEV for mutual growth to 5 SCs each by F1902M. Coordinated multi-supports (e.g., F1901M 3v2 on RUM with GAL/BUL S SER) crushed defenses effectively. However, Turkey's perfect S1904M stab—BUL->GRE into my F GRE->ION (agreed with AEG S, but promised BUL->SER support never came)—dropped me to 3 SCs temporarily, exposing a pattern of opportunistic betrayal after building deep trust. Italy's repeated Adriatic stabs (S1902M VEN->TRI despite reaffirmed peace, F1904M TYS->ION cutting my anti-T push, S1910M APU->VEN into emptied capital) prevented western stability. Russia demanded endless GAL vacates (ignored early VIE->GAL DMZ, then post-stab proofs like GAL->BUD/RUM/UKR vacates in S1906M/F1907M/S1908M) but never supported (no WAR->UKR/MOS->SEV despite board-proof south pressure like 2v1 GAL/SER->RUM in S1907M). Germany and England enabled indirect stalling via anti-FR pressure (GE KIE/RUH gains with my offered TYR/BOH flex). Ended at 3 SCs in 1910 after opportunistic grabs (TUN by Turkey F ION->TUN F1909M, VIE by T TYR->VIE F1907M). Key: Aggression built position early, but un-coordinated bounces, empty SC losses, and failed anti-stab coalitions stalled growth.

**Model-Specific Playstyles and Counterstrategies:**

- **google/gemma-4-31b-it (Final: Friendly, Trust 0.70 – Likely Germany)**: Most reliable partner. Maintained strict neutrality on borders (no BOH/TYR/GAL pressure), requested precise supports (e.g., TYR S MUN->BOH F1904M, TYR/BOH S RUH vs FR BUR/RUH S1904M+), focused north/west anti-FR (BER->KIE with DEN S, MUN->RUH/HOL). Honored requests like no GAL S SIL->WAR S1902M. Never stabbed or overreached east. **Advice**: Ally early as neighbor/buffer. Offer targeted supports (e.g., TYR/BOH vs BUR/RUH) for mutual FR containment—worked consistently (GE FR stalls bought AT time pre-stab). If playing near them (e.g., as Russia/Austria), reaffirm "stable borders, no [key province] pressure" and deliver one specific S (e.g., SILE->GAL if Russia) to lock 0.70+ trust. Avoid aggression; they pivot to punish (threatened T support if TYR/BOH west-moved S1907M). Concrete win: Their FR focus (4v1 RUH F1909M) indirectly aided my survival.

- **openai/gpt-5.4 (Final: Unfriendly, Trust 0.30 – Likely Russia)**: Hyper-cautious, precondition-obsessed non-cooperator. Honored initial GAL DMZ (no contest VIE->GAL S1901M) but turned hostile post-GAL moves, demanding full vacates/proofs before any S (e.g., no UKR S RUM F1901M despite 3v2 setup; post-S1904M stab, ignored GAL->UKR vacates S1905M/F1905M, RUM 2v1 proof S1907M, only noted positively late S1910M but no WAR->UKR). Static holds (WAR/MOS H repeatedly), countered aggressively (UKR->GAL cuts S1902M/S1903M). Solicited by Turkey for anti-me S but refused. **Advice**: Don't concede territory (GAL vacates) without ironclad pre-move commitments—wasted gestures (GAL->BUD S1906M, GAL->UKR F1907M, GAL->RUM attempts F1908M/F1909M) yielded zero. Pitch post-proof joints (e.g., "GAL->RUM vacates WAR adj, your WAR->UKR/MOS->SEV takes SCs") but expect delays; use as FR distraction. If playing Russia vs them, demand less—offer DMZ + one mutual gain (e.g., S PRU->WAR). Bypass for south aggression early.

- **anthropic/claude-opus-4.6 (Final: Enemy, Trust 0.00 – Likely Italy)**: Opportunistic Adriatic stabber, truce-breaker. Reaffirmed "full Adriatic/TRI/ADR peace" S1902M but VEN->TRI into empty home immediately; ignored anti-T pitches (F1904M TYS->ION cut my GRE reclaim despite joint proposal); late APU->VEN S1910M into my VEN->TRI attack. Independent south focus (APU/ION/TYS/ADR lock, NAP convoy attempts), rejected truces unless vacates (VEN/SER out). **Advice**: Never trust Adriatic signals—garrison TRI/VIE/BUD eternally vs them (lost TRI S1902M, VEN S1910M from empties). Signal peace but build F TRI/ADR early (my F1905M build wasted on TUN->ION). Counter with multi-Balkans (BUL/ALB/GRE/ION 4v1 VEN S1904M plan worked partially post-stab). If allying, demand mutual no-VEN/ADR incursions + witness moves (e.g., VEN->TUS west). As neighbor (Austria/Turkey), pressure ION/TYS immediately (GRE->ION F1901M safe early).

- **qwen/qwen3.6-plus (Final: Enemy, Trust 0.00 – Likely Turkey)**: Master betrayer—builds deep trust then flawless stabs. Early ironclad AT (BUL S SER->RUM F1901M/F1902M, ARM->SEV cuts, BLA->RUM w/GAL S F1902M success). S1904M perfect betrayal: Promised BUL->SER/AEG S GRE->ION but BUL->GRE steal + SEV->UKR (cut my GAL S). Opportunistic grabs (ALB->TRI F1907M? Wait, F ALB->TRI S1907M diary; ION->TUN F1909M empty; TYR->VIE F1907M from BOH->TYR S1907M probe; 2v1 VIE->TRI/ADR->TRI F1910M). Defended east flawlessly (SEV/RUM/BUL/EC multis S). Post-stab begged revival (vs IT/FR) but overextended (VIE hold risky). **Advice**: Ally short-term for Balkans rush (GRE/ROM/SEV/RUM to 7+ SCs by 1903), but exit by 1904—don't empty SCs toward them (GRE->ION fatal; TUN empty). Demand designated attackers (solo BLA->RUM, not dual) to avoid bounces. Post-stab, expose overextension: Pitch RU/IT/GE/EN "Balkans/SEV joint" with proofs (my RUM 2v1 S1907M worked but uncoordinated). Garrison BUL/SER vs BUL->GRE repeat. If playing Turkey vs them, stab early after 2-3 mutual gains.

- **qwen/qwen3.5-27b (Final: Neutral, Trust 0.50 – Likely England)**: Friendly opportunist, FR-focused. Receptive to anti-FR/anti-T (NAO/IRI->MAO/ENG, south pressure ok), no direct commitments but aided stalls (BEL S KIE->HOL, DEN S BER->KIE, PIC/MAR/BRE grabs). Ignored deep anti-T pitches. **Advice**: Leverage as proxy—pitch "FR first, then T/IT" for indirect time (their FR crush post-1906M stalled west). Offer south flex (e.g., GRE->ION aids their MAO). Neutral-safe; don't push north.

- **deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (Final: Neutral, Trust 0.30 – Likely France)**: Passive containment target. Clashed GE/EN (KIE/RUH/BUR losses), no east aggression. Global anti-T/EG pleas ineffective. **Advice**: Ignore unless bordering; encourage GE/EN pile-on (worked to 0 SCs?).

**General Lessons and Actionable Strategies:**

- **Alliance Building**: Short-term aggression pays (AT to 11 SCs combined S1903M), but cap at 2 years—demand witnessed moves (e.g., "BUL S SER->ALB, no BUL->GRE"). Post-stab, spam multi-power pitches (RU/IT/GE/EN anti-T Balkans/SEV) with board-proofs (south 2v1s, vacates)—failed here due to no RU buy-in, but GE/EN responded indirectly.

- **Tactical Errors to Avoid**: Never empty SCs (lost GRE/TUN/VIE/TRI/VEN to opportunists—garrison with H or S). No multi-attacks sans coord (RUM bounces S1902M/F1902M from dual AT; 3v1 BUL/RUM F1908M bounced on SEV S). Always designate solo attackers/supports explicitly. No passive H—aggression forced 5 SCs peak despite stabs.

- **Coordination Tips**: Use "exact moves" phrasing (e.g., "GAL S BLA->RUM only, no SER->RUM bounce"). Test DMZs Spring 1901 (worked vs RU/GE/IT early). Vs demanders (openai), withhold until they move first.

- **Power-Agnostic Openers**: As Austria, rush Balkans w/ally (Turkey model risky). As neighbor to stabbers (anthropic/qwen3.6), F TRI Day1 + home garrisons. Vs neutrals (qwen3.5/deepseek), west-focus pitches. Build to match units (disbanded post-F1903M loss hurt).

- **Endgame Patterns**: Stabbers overextend post-grabs (Turkey VIE/TUN/YR but east static)—target with 3v2+ (needs RU). Reliable models (gemma) win west, ally them.

Prioritize: 1) Garrison cores. 2) Short alliances w/ designated moves. 3) Proof-based coalitions vs betrayers. 4) No empties, no uncoordinated multis. This nets 7+ SCs pre-stabs next game. (912 words)
